title: Schindler operator profile
description: Schema for profile files in control-plane/profiles/factory/*.json and ~/.schindler/profiles/*.json. See docs/wiki/FACTORY-PROFILES.md.

schema_version.description: Semver for the profile-file format itself, independent of catalog_version.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version this profile was authored against. Daemon best-effort applies on profile.load and skips unknown ids; major-version mismatch is rejected.

name.description: Filesystem-safe identifier. Used as the .json filename stem.

description.description: Operator-facing one-liner. Optional but recommended for factory profiles.

factory.description: Informational only — read-only-ness comes from filesystem location, not this flag.

controls.description: Dot-namespaced catalog id → value. Enum values are strings (matching catalog options[].value); numerics are integers.
